svg.text: BARN HALL — MATTRESS PLATFORM AT MIRROR
All 8 twins packed edge to edge in the bay between the last beam and the mirror
75" edge runs across the room, 38" edge stacks
3 columns x 3 rows, one cell left spare = 8 mats
Platform uses 9'-6", leaving 1'-2" at the beam
158 sq ft mattress in a 209 sq ft bay = 76% covered
No mat crosses the beam line or the panel build-out
Zero gaps between mats — reads as one continuous
lounging surface rather than separate beds.
A 4th column will not fit: it needs 3'-2" and only
